changeSet.comment: Reset pre-commercial Rental operations and switch booking dates to inclusive semantics.

changeSet.author: loco-place
changeSet.comment: Add optional apartment number and one global Rental property display order.
changeSet.sql: with ordered as ( select id, row_number() over (order by created_at desc, id desc) - 1 as position from rental_property ) update rental_property property set display_order = ordered.position from ordered where property.id = ordered.id;

rollback.sql: alter table rental_property drop constraint ck_rental_property_display_order;
